description: Agent runtime composition root for Agentic OS
pre_install: Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.631.0/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '15cd20500a3ea7d6ddfa6f7eff0bf81516ee26c39f37f462004b1c006cb785e6') { throw 'aoscompose checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.631.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '7102aec72fc131b244a6204f261de7f2516b6639e13108ca1df2bcd2efec5d15') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
